candidate.answerReason: The five averages are 51, 51, 52, 52.5, and 51, respectively. The multiples of 5 have the largest average.

methods.label: Pair the smallest and largest
methods.explanation:
Each set consists of equally spaced numbers. Pair the smallest with the largest, the next smallest with the next largest, and continue inward. Every pair has the same sum, so the average of the whole set is the average of its first and last numbers. If one middle number remains, it equals that same average.

The first and last multiples in each set give
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{A: }&\frac{2+100}{2}=51,\\
\text{B: }&\frac{3+99}{2}=51,\\
\text{C: }&\frac{4+100}{2}=52,\\
\text{D: }&\frac{5+100}{2}=52.5,\\
\text{E: }&\frac{6+96}{2}=51.
\end{aligned}
\]
The largest average is \(52.5\), obtained by the multiples of \(5\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: Pairing equally spaced numbers derives the needed averaging shortcut using elementary arithmetic.
